metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully inserted a blank page after page 1 via Ctrl+Enter and saved. Document grew from 7 to 8 pages.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can insert page breaks, apply text formatting (bold/italic/underline) to selected text.
metadata.explanation: Chains page-break insertion with a formatting objective: make the title 'Sample Statutory Declaration' italic. Initially the title has italic=None (not italic), so the evaluator correctly rejects the initial state on both sub-checks. The getter reads the first paragraph's first run italic property. Partial credit: 0.5 per sub-goal. [Fixed: renamed getter/metric functions from invalid 8-char suffix '1dcd7b05' to correct 32-char MD5 '0f7fdf2d11eca0ddff6ddca8ba1c7a92' computed from 'ecc2413d-8a48-416e-a3a2-d30106ca36cb|2']
metadata.task_rationale: Combines the demonstrated page-break skill with a basic text-formatting capability to create a two-objective variant with content-formatting composition.

scoring_breakdown.page_break_inserted: 0.5 - At least 5 explicit page breaks present
scoring_breakdown.title_italic: 0.5 - Title paragraph first run has italic=True

fix_history: Fix 1: Renamed getter 'get_writer_break_and_title_italic__1dcd7b05' to 'get_writer_break_and_title_italic__0f7fdf2d11eca0ddff6ddca8ba1c7a92' (invalid 8-char suffix replaced with correct 32-char MD5 of 'ecc2413d-8a48-416e-a3a2-d30106ca36cb|2')
Fix 3: Updated evaluator.func and evaluator.result.type in JSON to use the correct 32-char MD5 hash

llm_judge_reasons: Both instruction requirements (blank page insertion and title italic) are covered by the evaluator with 0.5 partial credit each.
Metric correctly handles expected as the rules dictionary (no type='rule' parameter mishandling error).
Page break threshold of 5 is consistent with the documented claim that the initial state fails both checks, confirming calibration against the actual document.
Title italic check via doc.paragraphs[0].runs[0].italic correctly detects explicitly set italic (e.g., from Ctrl+I), returning True for italic and False/None otherwise.

Page break getter counts only run-level w:br type='page' elements; paragraph-level page breaks (w:pageBreakBefore) or section breaks would not be counted, which could cause false negatives if the document uses those structures.

Blank page verification is count-based and indirect — the evaluator does not verify that the inserted blank page is positioned after page 1 or that it is actually blank, only that the total page break count increased sufficiently.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider checking paragraph-level page breaks (w:pageBreakBefore in paragraph properties) in addition to run-level w:br type='page' elements to make page break detection more robust.
Consider adding a positional check to verify that a blank page exists specifically after page 1 content, rather than relying solely on total page break count.
If the title spans multiple runs, checking only runs[0] may allow false positives; consider checking that all runs in the title paragraph have italic=True.
